_about: Hand-kept inputs to scripts/power_model.py: measured figures that exist only in the docs, the bench sweeps to parse, the page's stated assumptions and its day presets. Every value carries its source. power.json is generated from this plus the firmware at deps.lock's pin; never edit power.json by hand.

knobs.conditions: BT, on the pack (VCELL 4.04-4.02 V) with USB data attached (the bench), current_map.py --set knobs at --hold 90 --settle 15: each knob alone from a shared dark floor (the RGB states with the screen off, the screen states with the RGB off), forward then backward; each state the mean of its two passes, from the INA228's charge register
knobs.screen_ticks_source: 36afff30e8's graphics/display.c, bkl_duty: the 24-level Screen the sweep ran on (P2b, 10-25, made it 0-100); each level's duty in ticks of 48, so scripts/power_model.py gives its levels on today's scale
knobs.rgb_path_source: 36afff30e8 drew a Solid colour as QMK's hsv_to_rgb with the CIE curve, each byte its drive; since D9 (v0.4.0) the flush applies the value through the firmware's own curve, so model.js gives each lit state the drive it ran at, by the pinned tree's hsv_to_rgb and CIE table, and places it where today's curve gives that light
knobs.blobs_source: git ls-tree 36afff30e83026d41b4654d7b4165086e8a5b440: the colour code the sweep rendered with. scripts/power_model.py fails if the pin's differ, since model.js would then re-render the sweep with code it did not run

percent.conditions: BT, on the pack (VCELL 4.11-4.09 V) with USB data attached (the bench), the screen off, current_map.py --set percent at --hold 25 --settle 10: white and a purple (hue 178, sat 219) by slider position, 1% to 100%, from a shared dark floor; each state the mean of its passes, from the INA228's charge register; each hold's model_mw is the board's own modelled draw at it
percent.rgb_path_source: d6656f9262 (row-isr, 11-05) has v0.4.0's wide path: rgb/curve12.h, quantum/color.c and led_tables.c, and battery.c are the release's blobs, and rgb/rowisr.c's flush, wide_width and drive accounting lines are unchanged to d59cb1fb0c (git diff, 11-13)
percent.blobs_source: git ls-tree d6656f926294024ab86b12a8f1580fa457d04f30. With battery.c the pin's too, the page's model must equal the board's own model_mw at every hold

sleep_mw.source: docs/power.md, 'Deep sleep: 3.2 mA on BT (13.25 mW), 3.3 mA on 2.4G (13.8 mW)'; the BT hour, 3.17 mA, 10-18/19

usb_data_mw.source: R2, 10-15: USB data attached costs ~1.7 mA (docs/test-bench.md); the firmware's P_USB_UW

radio_24g_awake_extra_mw.source: docs/power.md, 'Everything at max adds 2.4G's ~5 mW, which is one reading of the board with its lights off'. 2.4G with the lights on is unmeasured

reserve.source: docs/battery.md, 'The second run' (run 2, 10-02 to 10-04): lights-off typing after the RGB cut, screen at level 5, older firmware, observed once

drains.conditions: full white (value 255, saturation 0), screen at level 5, BT, typing as usual, full to the RGB cut
drains.source: docs/power.md, 'Measured: full white, from full to the cut'; R3: history/battery-2026-10-15-drain-2f/a1-summary.txt

tail_fraction.why: the low cap starts at 150 permille; the gauge as built does not guarantee that is 15% of the energy (plans/POWER-CHARTS-PLAN.md)

nominal_mv.why: to show mA beside mW: R3's mean pack voltage, full to the cut
